chunks: Yūnus ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated from Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام that he said:
Regarding a traveler who enters upon his family while he is junub before noon, and he has not eaten, then he must complete his fast and there is no qada' upon him.
He said: that means if his janabah was from ihtilam.

key_terms.الزَّوَالِ: midday/noon, the time relevant to the ruling
key_terms.الْمُسَافِرِ: the traveler whose fasting ruling is being discussed
key_terms.جُنُبٌ: in a state of janabah requiring ghusl
key_terms.صَوْمَهُ: his fast, which he must complete
key_terms.قَضَاءَ: making up a missed fast later

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a traveler who returns before noon in a state of janabah without having eaten?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a traveler who returns home before noon while in a state of janabah and has not yet eaten. He is to complete the fast and does not need to make it up, specifically in the case where the janabah resulted from ihtilam.
